rule: R4-name-household-fingerprint (ADVI_COTBKF TO-CB-ci-4). (a) name to household: keyed-hashed name tokens (lower case, alphanumeric, length >= 2, not all digits, stop list: the and of trust ira llc inc co lp ltd tod tenants joint fbo roth revocable living irrevocable custodian ttee jtwros acct account); a household hits at token overlap >= 0.6 (shared / shorter set) with its relationship_name, else its accounts' account_name; exactly one hit = unique, two or more = MULTI_HOUSEHOLD, none = NO_HOUSEHOLD. (b) client-line propagation for zero-hit accounts: the one household all MATCHED client-line siblings sit in, else none. (c) inside the household: candidates are the household's Black Diamond accounts no other matched Commonwealth account claims; R2 fingerprint per candidate (cusip else ticker, quantity within 0.001, cash excluded), PASS at >= 0.8. (d) window: gap in days = Black Diamond first-holdings date (first_transaction_date where no holdings) minus the Commonwealth account's last transaction date, over the 471 served matched pairs; band = narrowest symmetric band about the median holding >= 95%. (e) DETERMINISTIC = unique household, exactly one passing candidate, window_ok; CANDIDATE = unique household and a candidate scores >= 0.5 or is window_ok with the same registration class; else NONE. Guard: any wrong DETERMINISTIC in the control demotes every real DETERMINISTIC to CANDIDATE.

commonwealth_document_index: listing_fields: DisplayName (statement and transaction-report listings), ClientName (client letters), HouseholdName (household documents), Acct / Account / AccountNumber (fallback account key)
